content:
maria: Quick sync: ship week starts tomorrow. Two asks before we call code freeze at 16:00 UTC: 1) bump package versions where PRs touch proto/cli/runtime 2) add a one-line changelog entry to each PR. Please ack and note any blockers. I'll cut freeze at 16:00 UTC unless someone calls out a hot blocker by 15:00. @release-bot please record.

aj: ack. I've got infra-protos and cli queued. Will run bump script and open PRs now.

aj: PRs: https://github.com/redwood/infer/pull/612 (infra-protos bump), https://github.com/redwood/cli/pull/119 (cli minor). Need a quick review from @devon @sam

devon: looking. infra-protos bump lgtm, but there's a generated proto change — need CI green. Left a tiny comment re: timestamp in proto options.

sam: QA heads-up: smoke window 15:30-15:45 UTC tomorrow. Don't merge anything post-15:45 unless it's emergency. I'll run the smoke and post results.

olivia: docs: added a release-notes stub at https://github.com/redwood/docs/compare/release-draft-1783 and linked PRs. Need PR numbers for links — ping if you add more.

devon: added changelog line to runtime-fix PR #428: "fix: avoid double-kv cache eviction on short seq" — small.

security: Quick check: any new IAM role or secret rotation? If so, flag with 'security/needs-review' label. I saw a k8s-role change in infra-protos PR — I'll review ASAP.

qa-jen: I'll schedule canary runs after merge. If anyone expects long-running migrations, call it out now.

maria: thanks. @aj make sure bump script includes package.json and go.mod where needed: `./dev/bump_all.sh infra-protos 1.9.1` — also please add the changelog snippet to PR template.

aj: done, script run + pushed. CI started. pinging @devon for review. (reacted with :rocket:)

release-bot: AUTO: Freeze scheduled by @maria at 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z. Rollback window 00:30:00. Notifying channels: #eng-releases #qa #docs #security.

devon: CI green on infra-protos PR, merging shortly. docs links look fine.

olivia: :thumbsup: I'll tidy release notes after the merge and add links to final PRs.

sam: smoke ran on staging, all green. No blocking regressions. Will re-run pre-freeze.

maria: Final ask: if you haven't added a changelog line, do it now. I want all entries in the PR before freeze. Otherwise we'll roll them into the next patch.
